key.name: effect-enabled
key.description: Toggle the dynamic cursor scaling effect on or off.

key.name: min-move-scale
key.description: Scale multiplier as soon as the mouse starts moving slowly (1.0 = normal cursor size).

key.name: max-fast-scale
key.description: Maximum scale multiplier when moving the mouse fast.

key.name: max-speed-threshold
key.description: Pointer velocity (in pixels per second) at which the cursor reaches its maximum size.

key.name: grow-smoothing
key.description: How quickly the cursor expands when speed increases (0.05 to 1.0).

key.name: shrink-smoothing
key.description: How quickly the cursor shrinks back to normal size when slowing down or stopping (0.03 to 0.5).

key.name: hide-system-cursor
key.description: Hide the native hardware cursor while the scaled cursor is visible.
